name: Tells of generated interfaces

refresh.note: `reviewed` is the last monthly catalog review and `audited` the last quarterly re-audit of Altitude (the 2026-10-30 audit in Distinctiveness.md was the first). Update the date when you do one. `node build/checks/tells-freshness.mjs` warns in CI when either is overdue, and lists tells not seen in `retireAfterDays`. A major model release makes both due at once: set them back by hand to say so.

note: The visual and behavioural defaults that mark an interface as machine-generated, and where Altitude stands on each. Distinctiveness.md says how to use this file and when to refresh it; Research.md ("Generated interfaces converge") has the evidence. A tell is judged in a cluster, never alone. `detect` says what can catch it: `lint` (source text), `render` (a rendered preview), `measure` (the distinctiveness benchmark) or `human` (review). `altitude` is `clear`, `watch` (close to a tell, or depends on how it's used), `exposed` (matches a tell today) or `unchecked`. `lastSeen` is the last review that still found the tell common in generated output; retire a tell that hasn't been seen for two quarterly reviews.

tells.tell: Purple, indigo or violet gradients and accents (Tailwind's indigo-500 and its neighbours).
tells.note: No scheme uses the hue. The one violet in the sources is a ColorPicker swatch.

tells.tell: Gradient-filled headline text.
tells.note: No background-clip: text anywhere.

tells.tell: Dark by default, with a violet, periwinkle or neon accent.
tells.note: Nightfall is periwinkle #86a2ff on #121419. Dark isn't the default scheme.

tells.tell: A warm cream ground with a terracotta accent (the second-order default that replaced purple).
tells.note: Mesa (#b4441b on #f6f1ea) was retired on 2026-10-30 (#324); its name now renders as daylight.

tells.tell: Near-black with one acid-green or mint accent.
tells.note: Alpine (mint #5fd6b2 on #0f1513) was retired on 2026-10-30 (#324); its name now renders as nightfall.

tells.tell: Large coloured glows, or a neon glow under outlined rectangles.
tells.note: Shadows are always darker than the ground (Elevation, Research: light glows rejected).

tells.tell: Muted body text that fails WCAG AA, usually on dark grounds.
tells.note: Every text token clears 4.5:1 on all eight surfaces in both schemes.

tells.tell: A UI kit's palette left as shipped (shadcn neutrals, Tailwind blue-600).
tells.note: Altitude's palette is its own, but Daylight's #2b56d6 sits near Tailwind's blue-600 #2563eb. The landing page's accent swatches (until 2026-10-30) and the ColorPicker preview's swatches (until the tells lint, #320) were stock Tailwind values.

tells.tell: Inter, Roboto, Arial or the system stack as an unexamined default.
The "tasteful" free set: Space Grotesk, Geist, Instrument Serif, Fraunces.
tells.note: Instrument Sans is Instrument Serif's sibling; JetBrains Mono is the usual mono pairing. Kept after review (#325): Instrument Sans itself isn't on the lists, and the type rules differ from the defaults. Revisit if a quarterly audit finds generators reaching for it.

tells.tell: One serif-italic or accent-coloured word in an otherwise plain headline.
All-caps, letter-spaced labels (often mono) above every heading or section.
tells.note: None in bundle.css. The landing page's three (.kicker above every heading, .panel-label and .rung-tier) were removed on 2026-10-30: section kickers dropped, labels set in sentence case.

tells.tell: A font declared in CSS but never loaded.
tells.note: altitude.css loads its fonts; altitude.no-fonts.css falls back to system fonts by design. Checked statically by tells-lint.mjs (the preview pages leave the font import out, so a render can't judge it).

tells.tell: A centred hero in a generic sans, with a pill badge above the heading.
tells.note: The landing page hero is left-aligned, with a plain sentence-case line above the heading since TY4 was fixed.

tells.tell: Three identical icon-topped feature cards.
The stock section order: hero, logos, features, stats, pricing, call to action, four-column footer.
A grid of equal cards with no focal point, so a critical number sits beside a vanity one.
tells.note: Depends on how apps compose Card and Stat. checks/render-tells.mjs warns on four previews: the Stat group, PlanPicker, BillingPattern's plans and DeveloperSettingsPattern's apps.

tells.tell: Every screen is the same sidebar, top bar and card grid or table, whatever the task.
tells.note: framework/app-skeleton.md offers only this frame, and agents copy it.

tells.tell: One spacing value everywhere, so nothing groups.
tells.note: checks/render-tells.mjs finds no preview that stacks different sections with one gap.

tells.tell: A row of headline stats included by default.
Decorative 01 / 02 / 03 numbering on steps that aren't a sequence.
Heavy rounding and a soft shadow on everything, carrying no meaning.
tells.note: Altitude is rounded and shadowed by design; the defence is that every shadow is a tier with a non-height cue. Keep it that way.

tells.tell: Reflexive glassmorphism (frosted panels used as decoration).
tells.note: Only the dialog scrim blurs (3px), to make the page recede.

tells.tell: A coloured stripe on a card's top or left edge.
tells.note: Severity bars were rejected in E8. Artifact and Terminal, added later, turned their left edge critical on failure; found by the tells lint and removed in #374. Their failure is said in words, with a mark and Retry.

tells.tell: An icon inside a rounded, tinted square.
tells.note: Icons sit flush and never get their own surface.

tells.tell: Stock effect components (spotlights, beams, marquees, shimmer borders).
Kit components shipped unchanged, recognisable on sight.
tells.note: Props mirror shadcn/ui; the styles are Altitude's own. Theming's shadcn route must add the elevation states.

tells.tell: Missing or removed focus states.
Fake window-chrome dots on screenshots and code blocks.
tells.note: None on the landing page or in the previews.

tells.tell: The same fade-up on every section as it scrolls in.
tells.note: Motion only travels along the elevation axis and only for a change of state.

tells.tell: Bounce or elastic easing.
tells.note: ease-settle overshoots 2–3% on thumbs and indicators only; that is a settle, not a bounce.

tells.tell: Numbers that count up on first render.
tells.note: Charts never animate for decoration (Charts rule 7).

tells.tell: Animation that ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
Emoji as icons, in navigation or headings.
tells.note: No emoji in the interface (README).

tells.tell: A sparkle for anything AI.
A default icon set used without consideration.
tells.note: The README recommends Lucide for its matching grid and stroke. Kept after review (#325): the icon tells that read as generated are CM4 and IC2, both clear.

tells.tell: Generated or placeholder imagery and avatars.
tells.note: Trust in a site falls once its imagery is disclosed as generated (Research).

tells.tell: Marketese: unlock, seamless, supercharge, unleash, empower, effortless, revolutionise.
Placeholder-grade strings: "Welcome back!", "Something went wrong", "Oops", "OK", "Submit".
tells.note: Banned by the content rules.

tells.tell: A vague call to action with an arrow ("Get started →").
tells.note: None on the landing page or in the previews.

tells.tell: "The AI-powered [thing] for modern [audience]".
A blank or generic empty state.
tells.note: EmptyState and the async collection contract; applications still write the words.

tells.tell: A raw error string with no next step.
tells.note: Content rules and ErrorSummary.

tells.tell: A bare spinner while content loads.
tells.note: Await imprints components at their own size.

tells.tell: Design reasoning that the built screen doesn't carry out ("design theater").
tells.note: Applies to agents building with Altitude: check every stated choice against the build.

tells.tell: Missing status, error recovery and user control.
tells.note: The framework patterns' contracts and checks.

tells.tell: Fonts, colours, radii or navigation drifting from page to page.
tells.note: One token source.
